photos.c: Sarah Murphy – first Belgravian home in all four league races, and again in the Southern – and then the National as well,

Right: Sarah Murphy receives the Women's Cross Country Plate from Team Manager Catherine Eastham.  Sarah was unbeaten by a Belgrave runner in all six of the races that count for this competition. Photo by  Christine Bertram

Above: At the home UKWAL match at Sutton the Belles just missed stretching their win streak to cover two complete seasons.  Another four match points would have done it – but they don’t seem too downhearted as they now look forward to 2007 and UKWAL Division Two.

From left to right – standing: Juliet Fielden, Katryna Euridge, Eva Massey, John Vernon, Sarah Gailey, Jayne Anderson, Chris Privett, Claire Robinson, Bob Bridges (Joint Team Manager), Cynthia James (Joint Team Manager), Rex Bale, Carl Lawton, Jennifer Culley, Tony Fairclough, Sarah Murphy, Derek Jones, Ray James. Kneeling: Sarah Wellstead, Janine Whitlock, Gail Porter, Dian Holden, Hazel Mead.

Above: Sarah Murphy and Catherine Bryson tackle the SEAA Cross Country Championship at Holkham Hall, Norfolk, like every other race they’ve been in this winter – fighting for positions near the front of the field.
Above: Catherine Bryson front ran an exciting 1500m to win at Wigan. Also pictured is Sarah Murphy who placed 2nd in both 1500m and 3000m B races.

Sarah Murphy led home the Belles with a brilliant 4th place in the Surrey Cross Country Champs at Lloyd Park. But unfortunately Catherine Bryson badly twisted an ankle and we were one short of a full team.
